text:
leah: Quick PR to tighten pricing language, add a compact Reserved->$/1k token conversion, and unify SDK snippets (Node + Python). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4273
owen: I'll sanity-check numbers tonight and add EUR/GBP columns for examples.
maya: Pushed two snippets. Node uses `client.usage.getQuota()` helper. Example: ```js
const q = await client.usage.getQuota({ customerId });
console.log(`tier=${q.tier} burst=${q.burstRemaining}`);
```
sam: Fixed a broken /console/usage link I found and standardized wording to "per-1k tokens" across the PR.
leah: Add a brief note about quota headers and Dedicated behavior (when private billing disables metering).
sam: Confirmed runtime headers: `X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining` and `X-Redwood-Burst-Window-Seconds`. For Dedicated with metering disabled those headers are omitted. Node read example (in PR): ```js
const remaining = res.headers.get('x-redwood-quota-remaining');
const windowSec = res.headers.get('x-redwood-burst-window-seconds');
```
owen: Added a compact conversion table (Reserved GPUs -> tokens/sec -> monthly cost -> effective $/1k tokens) and a rounding rule note (round to 2 decimals). Included illustrative FX rates and a short disclaimer.
maya: Replaced the dashboard screenshot to use `tokens.ingested` and attached a tiny Grafana panel JSON snippet for SE import. Labeled streaming vs non-streaming SDK examples clearly.
leah: Please add a concise 4-item migration checklist for Hosted -> Dedicated (metering differences, headers, reserved pricing example, burst-credit behavior). Keep it under six bullets.
sam: Checklist added in a PR comment and I also added a CI smoke test that runs the Node example on Node 18.
devex-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-4273--docs.redwood.ai (linkscan, snippet-lint) :white_check_mark:
leah: Looks good. If there are no other objections I'll request final reviews and merge after CI is green. Thanks all! :rocket:
